attributes.description:
None kerning means no kerning after cascade exhaustion, not a zero threshold.
Language, alternative language and bookmark can also remain unspecified.

declarations.description: Empty/mutually exclusive declarations replace a slot as a whole.

endStyle.description: Separate insertion/empty-paragraph style; never applied to existing runs.

run.description: Index into SourceObject.paragraphs[paragraph]. Text is not copied here.

ChartDecimalNumber.description: Exact finite decimal spelling, never a JSON floating point number. Semantic validation limits normalized decimal exponent to -4096..4096 and lexical UTF-8 bytes to 1024. Null, blanks, error tokens and infinities are not numeric weights.

annotationChain.description: Most specific first. Missing declarations do not clear inherited fields.

components.description: Named data bindings, not final display order or formatted display text.

formattedComponents.description: Same order as components. Not assembled label text or render admission.

legendKeyVisible.description: Office displays a legend key only alongside a selected text component or tx.

textCascade.description: Index into text_cascades. None requires chart-style/default text resolution.

unresolvedFlags.description: Missing throughout the chain: application/chart-style defaults still needed.

schemaDefaulted.description: Present CT_Boolean/numFmt with omitted val/sourceLinked uses schema true.
Present CT_Boolean/numFmt with omitted val/sourceLinked uses schema true.

paragraphs.description:
Declared cascade only. Chart style/default, paint, fonts and layout remain
separate computations; None does not mean a shape default was selected.

propertyRoots.description: High to low priority, excluding the body itself. These are native txPr roots.

numerator.description: Unsigned decimal integer, before percentage formatting or rounding.

ExactWeightRatios.description:
Exact normalized magnitudes for percent labels. Denominator is stored once;
consumers must handle zero_total, not silently display a zero percentage.

NativeCoordinate.description: Native coordinate: bounded integer EMU or exact decimal universal measure.

NativePercentage.description: Exact native percentage: int32 thousandths of a percent or decimal percent; ranges depend on use.

oneOf.description: DrawingML chart text properties; retains its actual chart namespace.
DrawingML chart rich text; not a presentation shape text body.
Native table-style font collection; stored in the table style catalog.

rounded.description: The displayed numeric magnitude differs from the exact input.

offset.description: UTF-8 byte offset in the unmodified source format code.

oneOf.description: Measured advance of this glyph, not an ASCII-space substitution.
The layout engine repeats this glyph to fill remaining available width.

NumberSymbols.description: Explicit display symbols, independent of the machine's regional settings.

boundaryDecimalDigits.description: Bounds repeated prefix/total arithmetic even if only one weight is wide.

scaledDecimalDigits.description: Sum of exact integer widths after common decimal scaling, including zeros.

normalizations.description: Each required series is normalized once. Fractions are not sector angles.

textCascades.description: Unique native text cascades, shared by labels with the same declaration chain.

oneOf.description: Missing relationship or matching placeholder; no synthetic geometry.
Slide idx=0xffffffff is explicitly detached from layout matching.

TextStyleDeclaration.description:
Selected whole declaration. Consumers must still resolve its native semantics,
retained descendants, colors, theme fonts, resources, effects and permissions.
The reference is meaningful only with this result's immutable SourceIndex.
